body:
Windows POS 1.0.39+51

- Fix Lido summary amounts and transaction counts appearing as zero when logged in as YORBA. Wait for initial local summary synchronization before calculating combined totals.
- Organize receipt management by card batch. Show month/day, amount and transaction count in each batch row.
- Show payment-method totals and filters inside each batch, with larger POS text and icons.
- Show linked payment-record counts when an older batch has no saved transaction count. Do not double-count receipt photos or shared orders.
- Open receipt photos directly from the unassigned list. Use the separate link button to assign a batch.
- Preserve explicit batch assignments; use pickup dates to match only unassigned receipts to a unique batch.

Validation: Windows release build and local upgrade to 1.0.39+51 completed; receipt counting and batch-screen tests passed at 1024 and 1920 widths.
